cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:23966bf8-8174-45.title: Development Manager - Terrace Group
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:23966bf8-8174-45.description: ABOUT TERRACE GROUP HOLDINGS: Terrace Group Holdings is a Los Angeles–based real estate development firm focused exclusively on ground-up Class A self-storage assets in California. The firm sources, entitles, and builds climate-controlled storage facilities across Southern California’s highest-barrier markets. TGH currently has approximately $50 million of self-storage development under construction in Southern California, with a pipeline targeting $60 million or more of new development annually. The firm’s strategy combines disciplined site selection, deep municipal entitlement expertise, and hands-on development execution to deliver outsized risk-adjusted returns in a sector undergoing rapid institutional consolidation. TGH is a lean, founder-led organization where every team member has a direct line to decision-making and a tangible impact on the trajectory of the business. THE OPPORTUNITY: Reporting to the Director of Acquisitions & Development (or Managing Partner), this position is responsible for managing the pre-development and entitlement process for self-storage development projects, including coordinating with government agencies, managing consultants and third-party vendors, securing permits, and overseeing project schedules and budgets through construction.
responsibilities: Invoice processing and approval routing.
Document management and project-level filing.
Third-party follow-up and coordination on administrative matters.
Schedule management and timeline tracking.
Interact with accounting representatives on project-related expenses.
Oversight of Construction Manager’s day-to-day activities, deliverables, and reporting.
Oversight of contractors, subcontractors, and vendors related to project activities, invoices, and contract execution.
qualifications: BA/BS degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Urban Planning, or related field.
A minimum of five years of experience in real estate development and/or construction, with demonstrated knowledge of the entitlement, permitting, and construction process.
Experience with self-storage or industrial development preferred.
Familiarity with Southern California municipal entitlement and permitting processes preferred.
Strong understanding of the real estate development lifecycle from land acquisition through construction completion.
Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, and project management software.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously across different stages of development.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with government agencies, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
Detail-oriented with ability to manage schedules, budgets, and complex timelines.
Must be fluent in using AI tools and large language models (LLMs), with the ability to proactively apply them to research, analysis, drafting, and workflow efficiency.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:13f.team: 014 - River Oaks - Sur La Table, 1996 West Gray, Houston, TX 77019
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:13f.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Sales Associateat Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this role, you’ll support daily operations, deliver a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and help drive sales by sharing product knowledge. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Actively engage customers, identify their needs, recommend relevant products or experiences, and leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture Sales & Business Performance · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Promote add-on sales and support events that grow store traffic and customer engagement. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Collaborate with team members to maintain a positive, inclusive, and high-performing store culture · Support onboarding of new associates by sharing product knowledge and best practices Operations & Compliance · Accurately and efficiently process transactions including sales, returns, and price checks using the POS system. · Assist in daily opening and closing procedures, floor replenishment, and maintaining visual merchandising standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work · Available to work between 12 and 16 hours per week, with a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. While this is the minimum availability, scheduled hours may differ based on business needs. · Regular and predictable attendance Qualifications & Experience · Must be 18 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year of retail sales experience preferred. · Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. · Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences. · Proficiency in Microsoft Office and retail management syst

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:37f.title: Seasonal Ski Mounting Technician
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:37f.description: At Backcountry, our mission is to connect people to their passions. Our four online stores—Backcountry, Competitive Cyclist, MotoSport and, SteepandCheap—aim to supply our customers with the gear, knowledge, and inspiration necessary to get out there and chase down life’s greatest moments. We do this by providing the biggest and best assortment of premium outdoor products, superior shopping experience, personalized Gearhead expertise, lightning-fast and accurate fulfillment, and inspirational, informative, and community-centered content. Job Overview: The Ski Mounting Technician (Workshop/Back of House) is a behind-the-scenes specialist responsible for the precise mounting, adjustment, and inspection of ski bindings. This role prioritizes adherence to technical standards, manufacturer protocols, and quality assurance. The ideal candidate is experienced, mechanically inclined, detail-focused, and comfortable working independently in a workshop setting. Schedule: - Full-time/Part-time - During peak season, there will be mandatory overtime, including some Saturdays and Sundays around Black Friday thought Cyber Monday, depending on business needs. This is a Seasonal Position with a maximum employment period of six (6) months based on job performance and business needs.
responsibilities: Accurately mount, calibrate, test, and release-check ski bindings following current manufacturer specifications and industry safety standards.
Use specialized workshop tools (e.g., mounting jigs, torque wrenches, release testers) and maintain their calibration.
Use warehouse management and mounting software.
Inspect skis and bindings for wear, structural issues, or safety concerns, documenting work performed and flagging any defects.
Support the inventory, care, and maintenance of workshop tools, equipment, and consumables.
Uphold cleanliness and organization of the workshop to meet safety and operational standards.
Collaborate with front-of-house and management for workflow efficiency and prioritize complex custom setups as needed.
qualifications: Candidate must be 18 years of age or older.
Previous experience as a ski tech or with mounting bindings preferred; technical/mechanical background considered an asset.
Proficient with standard ski tech tools and equipment; ability to interpret technical mounting charts and instructions.
Strong manual dexterity and ability to complete fine mechanical tasks accurately and efficiently.
Proven attention to detail and adherence to safety/quality procedures.
Self-motivated and able to work without direct guest interaction.
Willingness to work flexible schedules, including evenings and weekends during peak season.

jobandtalent-jobandtalent:lever:268aa722.title: DE - Senior Accountant (German Market)
jobandtalent-jobandtalent:lever:268aa722.description: Join us to shape the future of work: your next adventure awaits! We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on and proactive Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Germany. This is a key role for the German finance organization. You will be responsible for core accounting activities, including monthly and annual closing, VAT, reconciliations, statutory reporting and audit support. At the same time, you will act as the accounting lead for Germany — guiding team members and serving as the main local counterpart to the Global Accounting team on German accounting matters. As part of the Accounting Team, you will ensure total compliance with German statutory and business requirements. Success requires deep technical accounting knowledge, sharp judgment, and the confidence to take a definitive stance on regulatory and financial standards. This is a fully remote position, allowing you to work from anywhere. Relocation to Germany is not required, as we offer 100% remote work while supporting the German finance organization.
qualifications: Proven experience in a senior accounting role, ideally within an international, complex or fast-growing company.
Strong knowledge of German accounting standards, the German Commercial Code (HGB), VAT and statutory reporting requirements.
Experience in preparing annual financial statements and corporate income tax returns.
Hands-on experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP system.
Experience in reviewing accounting work and guiding more junior colleagues.
Ability to work both operationally and strategically — from detailed reconciliations to advising on accounting implications.
High attention to detail and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.
Strong communication skills and confidence in collaborating with both local management and global finance teams.
Proactive, structured and solution-oriented mindset.
Fluency in German and English.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1cb709fd-f2a9-.title: Senior Field Clinical Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1cb709fd-f2a9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Field Clinical Specialist based in the United States. This is a senior clinical affairs opportunity supporting innovative, minimally invasive solutions in the vascular care space. You’ll serve as a highly experienced clinical resource, helping guide complex clinical research, trials, and data-collection activities. The role combines hands-on clinical expertise with responsibility for study planning, execution, compliance, and reporting. You’ll collaborate with investigators, clinicians, regulatory stakeholders, and internal teams to advance clinical programs and support product development. Your expertise will help ensure clinical protocols are followed, studies progress effectively, and safety and regulatory responsibilities are managed appropriately. The position is remote while requiring extensive travel across the United States, with regional coverage centered around Atlanta or Dallas. It offers an opportunity to apply direct Cath Lab and medical-device experience to high-impact clinical programs within a global healthcare environment. Serve as a senior clinical affairs resource responsible for the direction, planning, execution, and oversight of complex clinical trials, research, and data-collection activities. Support the implementation of clinical protocols and contribute to the completion of final study reports and related documentation. Recruit clinical investigators and collaborate with them on study design, costs, timelines, and execution requirements. Direct Phase III and Phase IV human clinical trials supporting products under development. Coordinate and oversee investigator initiations, group studies, and other clinical research activities. Monitor clinical sites and clinicians for adherence to approved study protocols and applicable requirements. Track study progress, assess completion status, and help ensure clinical programs remain on schedule. Participate in adverse-event reporting and safety monitoring activities, ensuring relevant issues are appropriately identified and addressed. Coordinate clinical information and reporting needed for submissions or reports to regulatory agencies. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders as a clinical consultant or liaison when supporting partnerships or licensing arrangements. Apply specialized clinical knowledge to identify solutions to complex issues and contribute to improved clinical and research practices. Requirements Associate degree or equivalent relevant education. 7+ years of relevant professional experience in a clinical or medical affairs environment. Direct clinical Cath Lab experience is required. Previous medical device industry experience is required. Strong understanding of clinical research, medical affairs, clinical protocols, and clinical data-collection processes. Experience working with clinical investigators and multidisciplinary healthcare teams. Ability to manage complex projects, prioritize competing requirements, and operate independently in a field-based environment. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clinicians, investigators, regulatory stakeholders, and internal teams. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing clinical documentation, study requirements, and compliance activities. RN or RT credentials combined with Cath Lab experience are preferred. Previous clinical trial and/or clinical research experience is preferred. Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 80% travel within the United States . Ability to work in environments requiring prolonged periods of sitting and standing. Benefits Salary: Base pay range of $78,000–$156,000 , with actual compensation potentially varying by location and other relevant factors. Remote work: Remote position with regional cove

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4bda06fc-51f3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions & Communications Architect (Fractional Contract) based in India. This is a senior architecture role focused on designing and launching a secure, unified communications and workflow platform. You will lead the architecture from initial discovery through the delivery of a working pilot. The scope spans identity, data protection, integrations, approvals, monitoring, and auditability. You will work with AI-enabled workflows and automated systems while maintaining strong human oversight and security controls. The first month is highly hands-on and fast-paced, with a transition afterward to a lighter ongoing engagement of approximately 8 hours per week. This role offers significant autonomy and ownership, with a strong emphasis on thoughtful engineering and risk management. It is ideal for an experienced architect who can move quickly while knowing when to pause, challenge assumptions, and protect system integrity. Lead the discovery and architecture of a secure, unified communications and workflow environment connecting teams and systems with a central platform. Understand business, technical, security, and operational requirements thoroughly before designing or implementing solutions. Design end-to-end architectures covering identity verification, access controls, data protection, integrations, system connectivity, monitoring, and audit trails. Establish approval checkpoints and human-in-the-loop controls to ensure sensitive communications, actions, and data transfers are properly reviewed before execution. Build and launch a functional pilot within the initial intensive delivery period, including monitoring, backup plans, validation processes, and evidence that the solution operates as intended. Review technical work and deliverables from team members, identifying security, quality, architectural, or completeness concerns and redirecting work when necessary. Document architectural decisions, assumptions, risks, security considerations, and recommended next steps to support long-term scalability and governance. Support the continued maintenance, optimization, and expansion of the platform during the ongoing fractional engagement. Evaluate AI-assisted analysis and design outputs critically, ensuring automated recommendations are independently validated before being incorporated into production solutions. Requirements Senior-level experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, integration architecture, platform architecture, security architecture, or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated experience designing and building AI-enabled workflows, case or work-management platforms, automated systems, or solutions incorporating robust audit trails. Strong knowledge of identity and access management, data protection, least-privilege principles, security controls, and secure system design. Proven experience designing secure environments for multiple clients, organizations, or user groups while maintaining strict data isolation. Experience translating ambiguous or evolving requirements into practical, secure, and scalable technical solutions. Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, architecture, and design while maintaining personal accountability for validating their outputs. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and non-technical executives. Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, make sound technical judgments, and take ownership of quality and security. Experience designing systems for users with varying levels of technical proficiency is a plus. A track record of rapidly turning unclear requirements into safe, functional pilots is highly valued. Willingness to challenge assumptions and stop or escalate work when a solution is not secure, sufficiently

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d0256615-fc1e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer - PostgreSQL based in Italy. This is an opportunity to join a distributed open-source software team focused on PostgreSQL and related database technologies. You’ll own the creation of clear, accurate, and user-oriented technical documentation across the product lifecycle. Working closely with engineers, product managers, QA, and fellow technical writers, you’ll turn complex technical concepts into practical resources for diverse audiences. The role combines technical writing, documentation strategy, developer tooling, and hands-on exploration of database systems. You’ll work in a docs-as-code environment and use modern AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work. With a high degree of autonomy, flexible working hours, and a global team, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys both deep technical work and collaborative open-source environments. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including installation and configuration guides, troubleshooting resources, how-to articles, user manuals, man pages, help prompts, and release documentation. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, developers, QA specialists, and other technical writers to produce accurate, timely, and high-quality documentation. Translate complex PostgreSQL and database concepts into clear, accessible content for users with different levels of technical expertise. Use Markdown, text, images, diagrams, and other formats to create engaging and effective documentation. Work within a docs-as-code methodology, maintaining documentation through version-controlled workflows and contributing to scalable documentation practices. Leverage AI-powered tools to draft, refine, structure, format, and improve technical content while maintaining accuracy and quality. Participate actively in team ceremonies, technical discussions, planning sessions, and other collaborative activities. Contribute to the broader documentation strategy and continuously improve writing standards, workflows, and processes. Engage with open-source communities through forums, mailing lists, and other communication channels, sharing knowledge and gathering technical insights. Research new technologies and contribute to upstream documentation, technical blog content, or other knowledge-sharing initiatives when appropriate. Help develop and maintain automated documentation testing, validation processes, and CI/CD workflows where applicable. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as a Technical Writer, with a proven ability to produce precise, high-quality technical documentation. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical subjects clearly and effectively. Experience documenting complex software systems and producing user-oriented documentation for technical audiences. Strong familiarity with markup languages, particularly Markdown. Hands-on experience installing and configuring database server software on Linux. Practical experience with docs-as-code methodologies and tools such as Git, Jenkins, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript. Experience using AI tools to support technical documentation workflows. Comfortable working with the Linux command line and developer tools such as Git, GCC, and GDB. Understanding of distributed systems and/or database server development. Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively within a globally distributed organization. Strong collaboration skills and experience communicating through tools such as Slack, Jira, Notion, Zoom, mailing lists, and community forums. Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, solve problems independently, and contribute positively as part of a distributed team. A developer or DevOps background is highly valued. Experience contributing to PostgreSQL or other open-source

jobgether-jobgether:lever:dc9e715a-3bab-.title: Technical Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:dc9e715a-3bab-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Account Manager based in Germany. As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a strategic and technical partner to large enterprise customers throughout their entire journey. You will guide customers from onboarding and implementation through long-term adoption, retention, and expansion. The role combines technical expertise, project management, customer success, and consultative problem-solving. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Engineering, and other teams to deliver solutions that create measurable customer value. Your curiosity and ability to understand complex data environments will help customers get the most from a sophisticated technology platform. You will also bring customer feedback and emerging use cases back to internal teams to influence product evolution. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-moving, collaborative, and technology-driven environment. Own the technical customer journey from kickoff and onboarding through ongoing success, adoption, retention, and expansion. Manage and execute customer-facing technical projects, ensuring onboarding activities are well organized, timely, and aligned with customer objectives. Build strong relationships with enterprise customers and develop a deep understanding of their business requirements, technical environments, use cases, and challenges. Provide proactive technical guidance and recommend best practices to help customers maximize the value and adoption of the platform. Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities to increase platform adoption and support the growth of strategic accounts. Collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other internal teams to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and escalations. Translate customer requirements into practical, efficient solutions while helping customers navigate complex technical systems. Identify emerging customer use cases, recurring challenges, and product opportunities, and communicate these insights to Engineering and other product teams. Serve as a trusted advisor who can balance technical depth with business priorities and customer outcomes. Manage competing priorities, deadlines, and unexpected roadblocks while maintaining a high standard of customer service. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in a client-facing and/or technology-focused role combining strong business understanding with technical expertise. Demonstrated experience managing and delivering technical projects with a customer-first mindset and strong empathy for customer needs. Excellent project management, organization, written communication, and verbal communication skills. Strong ability to quickly learn new technologies and understand complex technical environments, including SQL, databases, APIs, reporting tools, and related systems. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with a genuine interest in continuously developing technical expertise. Ability to understand customer requirements at a detailed level and translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders with different technical backgrounds and responsibilities. Ability to remain composed and effective under pressure, manage deadlines, and navigate unexpected challenges with confidence. A customer-oriented, curious, proactive, and consultative approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Willingness and ability to work in a fast-paced technology environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Benefits: Competitive compensation package. Meaningful equity compensation through ISO options. Early exercise opportunities for eligible equity. 10-year post-termination exercise window for equity

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:ea59c6.title: Data Engineer
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:ea59c6.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to own and scale our data platform. You will maintain and optimize our pipelines, design new ingestion processes, and support the data needs of our product, data science, and go-to-market teams. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with modern data tooling, improving performance and reliability, and building the foundation for machine learning-powered features. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Maintain and improve data pipelines to keep data flowing reliably from ingestion to delivery - Optimize performance and costs across Snowflake, Clickhouse, AWS, dbt, and Dagster - Own data quality by implementing monitoring, alerting, and validation - Manage and extend infrastructure, including orchestration and CI or CD for data workflows - Support MLOps as machine learning models are developed and productionized - Be on call for critical pipelines and respond quickly to issues - Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to launch new data products WHO YOU ARE - Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining production data pipelines - Proficiency in Python and SQL - Hands-on experience with dbt, orchestration frameworks such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect, and AWS - Familiarity with Snowflake, Clickhouse, or other modern data warehouses - Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset - Experience with or interest in MLOps and supporting machine learning workflows in production - Strong sense of ownership and accountability for data quality and reliability - Motivated by access to rare and interesting AI data based on real human interactions with large language models - Excited by the opportunity to own and shape Profound’s data platform at an early stage - Interested in working on meaningful problems at the intersection of AI and marketing - Comfortable in a fast-moving culture with autonomy, trust, and room to grow - Drawn to competitive compensation and meaningful equity LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $140,000 to $260,000. Comp may vary by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. #LI-DNI Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:24ad1887-7.title: Growth Engineer
southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:24ad1887-7.description: ABOUT TOWN Town is an AI-powered assistant that connects to your tools to do real work on your behalf — triaging your inbox, drafting in your voice, managing your schedule, and running workflows across everything you use. It knows you deeply and gets sharper over time. ABOUT THE ROLE Town is a product-led growth (PLG) company, and the product itself is our best growth channel. We're looking for a Growth Engineer who gets genuine joy out of moving the numbers: pulling people into Town, getting individuals onto teams, getting teams onto paid, and turning teams into enterprise customers. The skillset overlaps heavily with our Product Engineers — you'll ship real product, fast. The difference is what makes you tick. As a Growth Engineer at Town, you're energized by things like optimizing the invite flow, the conversion funnel, and the dashboard: invites per user, free-to-paid conversion, whether credits are calibrated right, how to make every loop faster, more delightful, and more discoverable. This is a foundational, high-leverage role.
